verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions (event-driven CI/CD automation) is only glancingly referenced via 'Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD' and 'Extend your stack with apps, actions, and AI models' — no explicit documentation of defining workflows/rules triggered by repo events (push, PR, issue, schedule, webhook). Missing for 10: explicit docs on GitHub Actions workflow triggers/events, examples of rule definitions (YAML on: conditions), and independent corroboration of automation depth.
